QUOTE: `library/memory_buffer_alloc.c` is an allocator the library ships. `mbedtls_memory_buffer_alloc_init(buf, len)` (line 566) calls `mbedtls_platform_set_calloc_free` with its own functions
VERDICT: MISS
WHY: The answer says the buffer allocator installs itself via the setter at init. It never says it is the only in-tree user, and it never names MBEDTLS_MEMORY_BUFFER_ALLOC_C.
